question:
Fill in the blank with the correct idiom selecting from the given alternatives.

option_3: put one’s money where one’s mouth is
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. the last straw.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The idiom "The last straw" means final irritation.

◦ (सहने की हद)

• The completed sentence reads: His constant lateness had annoyed her for months, but missing the wedding was the last straw.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. the last straw.

• Option 1: on tenterhooks (बेचैनी में): This idiom means very anxious, which does not fit the context of the given sentence.

• Option 3: put one’s money where one’s mouth is (केवल बातें नहीं, काम करो): This idiom means support with action, which does not fit the context of the given sentence.
